answer:
SELECT CASE WHEN h.hla_a_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_A_Val')::real THEN 'A-locus' WHEN h.hla_b_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_B_Val')::real THEN 'B-locus' WHEN h.hla_dr_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_Dr_Val')::real THEN 'DR-locus' END AS mismatch_locus, COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
JOIN hla_info h ON h.immu_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND cm.hla_mis_count = 1
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
note: Filtered on stored hla_mis_count = 1; recomputing mismatches from donor/recipient HLA values never yields exactly 1 (all such matches differ on all three loci), so the locus CASE assigns every row to A-locus.

WITH base AS (
 SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, ar.tx_cen_code AS center_id,
   (re.riskmetrics->>'Infect_Risk')::numeric AS infect_risk,
   (mh.viralstatinfo->>'Cmv_State' = 'Positive' AND ri.cmv_state = 'Negative') AS cmv_mismatch
 FROM transplant_matching tm
 JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON ar.adm_rev_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 JOIN medical_history mh ON mh.contrib_med_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
 JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
 LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 WHERE tm.match_status IN ('Completed','In Progress'))
SELECT b.match_rec_registry, b.center_id, b.infect_risk,
 ROUND((SELECT AVG(o.infect_risk) FROM base o WHERE o.center_id = b.center_id AND NOT o.cmv_mismatch), 4) AS avg_center_infect_risk_no_mismatch
FROM base b WHERE b.cmv_mismatch ORDER BY b.center_id, b.match_rec_registry

WITH p AS (
 SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, tm.org_spec, ri.life_support,
  0.7 * CASE WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4 WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2','2') THEN 3 WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3','3') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END + 0.3 * (substring(c.wait_time from '(\d+)')::numeric / 365.0) AS urgency
 FROM transplant_matching tm
 JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
 JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
 WHERE tm.match_status = 'Pending')
SELECT p.recip_ref_reg, p.life_support, ROUND(p.urgency, 4) AS urgency_score,
 ROUND((SELECT AVG(o.urgency) FROM p o WHERE o.org_spec = p.org_spec AND o.life_support IS NULL), 4) AS avg_non_life_support_urgency
FROM p WHERE p.life_support IN ('ECMO','VAD') ORDER BY p.org_spec, p.urgency
note: med_urgency holds both 'Status 2'/'Status 3' and bare '2'/'3'; bare values treated as the same statuses.

WITH t AS (
 SELECT tm.dss_val, 1.0/(1+EXP(-(-0.5 + 1.5*(0.6*CASE WHEN lower(cm.blood_compat)='compatible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + 0.4*(1 - cm.hla_mis_count/6.0)) - 0.02*substring(d.age_count from '(\d+)')::numeric))) AS egs
 FROM transplant_matching tm
 JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
 WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'),
b AS (SELECT MIN(dss_val) AS mn, MAX(dss_val) AS mx FROM transplant_matching WHERE match_status = 'Completed')
SELECT WIDTH_BUCKET(t.dss_val, b.mn, b.mx, 5) AS dss_bucket, COUNT(*) AS transplant_count, ROUND(AVG(t.egs), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM t CROSS JOIN b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
note: EGS computed from the knowledge formula (S_immune from blood_compat and hla_mis_count, donor age); plain WIDTH_BUCKET puts the max value in bucket 6.

WITH t AS (
 SELECT l.trans_method, (substring(fr.org_isch_time from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric + substring(cm.exp_isch_time from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric) AS isch_mins,
  substring(cm.distance from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric * 1.60934 AS dist_km
 FROM transplant_matching tm
 JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 JOIN function_and_recovery fr ON fr.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
 JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed')
SELECT trans_method, ROUND(AVG(isch_mins/dist_km), 4) AS avg_efficiency_ratio, ROUND(MIN(isch_mins/dist_km), 4) AS min_efficiency_ratio, ROUND(MAX(isch_mins/dist_km), 4) AS max_efficiency_ratio
FROM t WHERE dist_km >= 10 GROUP BY trans_method ORDER BY avg_efficiency_ratio
note: Total ischemia = org_isch_time + exp_isch_time (assumed); distance stored in miles, converted to km.

answer:
SELECT ri.immu_recip_registry, ri.pra_score, ri.dsa_state,
 CASE WHEN ri.pra_score >= 80 AND ri.dsa_state = 'Positive' THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Standard Risk' END AS amr_risk_level,
 (SELECT MAX(tm.created_ts) FROM transplant_matching tm WHERE tm.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry) AS last_match_ts
FROM recipients_immunology ri
WHERE ri.cross_result = 'Positive'
ORDER BY ri.pra_score DESC

SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, ad.allc_region, c.med_urgency, cm.hla_mis_count,
 RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.allc_region ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4 WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2','2') THEN 3 WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3','3') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, cm.hla_mis_count ASC) AS region_rank
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN allocation_details ad ON ad.allc_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Pending' AND tm.org_spec = 'Pancreas'
ORDER BY ad.allc_region, region_rank
note: Bare '2'/'3' urgency values treated as Status 2/Status 3.

WITH c AS (
 SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, tm.donor_ref_reg, tm.recip_ref_reg,
  replace(cm.cost_est, 'US$', '')::numeric / (5 * re.qol_val::numeric) AS cer
 FROM transplant_matching tm
 JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND tm.org_spec = 'Lung' AND re.qol_val > 0),
n AS (SELECT c.*, NTILE(20) OVER (ORDER BY cer) AS bucket FROM c)
SELECT match_rec_registry, donor_ref_reg, recip_ref_reg, ROUND(cer, 2) AS cer
FROM n WHERE bucket IN (1, 20) ORDER BY cer

WITH opt AS (
 SELECT d.physicalstats->>'Ethnicity' AS donor_ethnicity, r.ethn_grp AS recipient_ethnicity
 FROM transplant_matching tm
 JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
 JOIN recipients_demographics r ON r.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
 WHERE lower(cm.blood_compat) = 'compatible' AND cm.hla_mis_count = 0
   AND 1 - ABS((d.physicalstats->>'Bmi_Value')::numeric / r.bmi_val::numeric - 1) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.1)
SELECT donor_ethnicity,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'African') AS african,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Asian') AS asian,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Caucasian') AS caucasian,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Hispanic') AS hispanic,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Other') AS other
FROM opt GROUP BY donor_ethnicity ORDER BY donor_ethnicity
note: ABO compatibility taken from the (case-noisy) blood_compat column rather than derived from blood types.

WITH t AS (
 SELECT l.trans_method, (substring(fr.org_isch_time from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric + substring(cm.exp_isch_time from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric) AS isch_mins, 1.0/(1+EXP(-(-0.5 + 1.5*(0.6*CASE WHEN lower(cm.blood_compat)='compatible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + 0.4*(1 - cm.hla_mis_count/6.0)) - 0.02*substring(d.age_count from '(\d+)')::numeric))) AS egs
 FROM transplant_matching tm
 JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 JOIN function_and_recovery fr ON fr.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
 JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
 JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
 WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed')
SELECT trans_method, ROUND(AVG(isch_mins), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_mins, ROUND(AVG(egs), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM t GROUP BY trans_method ORDER BY avg_egs_score DESC
note: EGS computed from knowledge formula rather than risk_evaluation.egs_val; ischemia = org_isch_time + exp_isch_time.
